system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 2 Basic, 2 Intermediate, 1 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Basic (2): Shadow Play, Shroud of Night
  • Intermediate (2): Arms of the Abyss, Black Metamorphosis
  • Advanced (1): Tenebrous Form

Base rating-tracker for the Obtenebration Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book One: Magisters
